## Objectives

1. Defeat 30 Downs Boar on the Thyme Bankss ([Downs Boar](../monsters/downs_boar.md)) in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
2. Talk to [Wat](../npcs/wat.md)

- 480 mesos
